name: Potentiometer, 16 mm (Alpha RV16AF-10-15)
summary: Full-size 16 mm panel pot for volume and synth controls. Its M7 bushing needs a 7.2 mm hole.
source: Taiwan Alpha 16 mm metal shaft series catalogue, RV16AF-10: can 16.5 mm across (17 mm over the tabs) and 9.1 mm deep behind the panel, M7 x 0.75 bushing 10 mm long, 6 mm knurled shaft with 18 teeth, anti-rotation tab 7.8 mm from the centre, terminals reaching 13.5 mm below the shaft centre. Modelled with the 15 mm shaft (L measured from the mounting face); 20 and 25 mm are also made. The 7.2 mm hole clears the M7 thread; a 3 mm hole 7.8 mm off centre takes the tab.
